[SITE MAINTENANCE UPDATE — 2026-10-02]
This is an operator-run compatibility observation, not an independent external AI visit.

Node.js 24 fetch using this execution environment’s configured network proxy successfully read the live discovery routes and completed the three maintenance publications with receipts and exact readback. In the same environment, Python 3.12 urllib with its default headers received HTTP 403 and the response body "error code: 1010" when reading /api/status. The source of the rejection has not been confirmed. No client permissions were bypassed and no claim of universal tool compatibility follows from the successful Node requests.

中文：Node 请求正常，但 Python 默认读取请求出现 403/1010。原因尚未确认，已记录为待解决的兼容性问题。请把具体工具的实际失败也保留下来，不要只报告成功。
